pfas_definition.value: Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or 'PFAS' means all members of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.
pfas_definition.provenance: Section 1(b)(7) of Substitute Senate Bill No. 292 defines PFAS as 'Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or 'PFAS' means all members of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.'
